power.answer: China Southern allows power banks of up to 100 Wh in the cabin only, never in checked baggage. Power banks of 100 to 160 Wh need China Southern's approval, with at most 2 per passenger, and anything above 160 Wh or with no readable rating is prohibited.

sections.h: 🔋 What China Southern says about power banks
sections.p: From the China Southern General Conditions of Carriage for Passenger and Baggage, section 4.5.4.4 "Restrictions on Power Banks", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
China Southern rule
rows: Only with approval from China Southern, no more than 2 per passenger
Strictly prohibited (also if the energy cannot be worked out from the marked values)
Not allowed in cabin baggage loaded in the overhead storage locker
In the seat back pocket, or under the seat in front, or where the crew designates
Kept turned off at all times; no charging devices from it and no charging the power bank itself; a bank with a switch stays off

faq: Can I put a power bank in my checked bag on China Southern?
No. Power banks are forbidden in checked baggage and must stay with you in the cabin.
Can I use my power bank on a China Southern flight?
No. It must stay turned off, and you may not use it to charge a device or charge the power bank itself.
What size power bank is allowed on China Southern?
Up to 100 Wh in the cabin; 100 to 160 Wh only with approval and no more than 2; above 160 Wh is prohibited.
